unverified: City of Fort Myers: golf carts are not allowed on public roads or sidewalks (FMPD, 2024), except gated communities, golf courses, and official use. Applied to public roads inside the city limits. Outside the city, plain golf carts stay red on public roads unless designated (F.S. 316.212).
LSVs follow F.S. 316.2122 (roads posted 35 mph or less) inside and outside the city.

bans.label: US 41 / Tamiami: typically 45+ mph, not LSV

enforcement.note: Bintelli Fort Myers store (16850 S Tamiami Trl) sits just outside the Fort Myers Beach (Estero Island) region and outside the City of Fort Myers limits.
